links.outcome: Whether MLLM dental radiograph interpretations flagged diagnostic uncertainty
links.effect: Errors included unflagged diagnostic uncertainty, along with conclusion-rationale inconsistency, artifact-induced false positives, low-contrast false negatives and spatial localization errors. No numeric rate reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Errors included artifact-induced false positives, low-contrast-induced false negatives, spatial localization errors, conclusion-rationale inconsistency, and unflagged diagnostic uncertainty.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluation of zero-shot multimodal large language models on dental radiography tasks compared with clinician performance.
